steps.caption: 进入售后时下载对应分包；页面显示订单仍需要另外读取数据。拆包没有减少总代码。

items.title: 入口与公共资源放主包
items.text: 入口页及普通分包共同需要的资源放在主包里，一项功能的页面与专属资源可以放入对应分包。

items.title: 按进入的功能加载
items.text: 打开分包里的页面可以触发该包下载。预下载和缓存会改变实际时机，应该看下载记录确认，而不是凭感觉判断。

modules.title: 分包能让订单请求更快吗
modules.text: 分包不会自动解决接口慢，也不会直接减少总代码。包大小限额和独立分包的规则依平台而定，需要时查看当前官方文档。

lessonPractice.title: 售后页已移到分包，首页与公共组件留在主包。没有预下载和缓存，首次只打开首页会下载什么？

options.label: 先下载主包，进入售后时再取售后分包
options.feedback: 题目的条件下，首页不需要先下载售后代码。

options.label: 只读取订单数据，页面代码都留在服务器
options.feedback: 运行首页仍需要先取得主包中的页面代码。

options.label: 仍把主包与售后分包一起全部下载
options.feedback: 普通分包的作用正是让未用到的功能代码不必随入口一起加载。

en.title: Support pages moved to a subpackage, while the home screen and shared components stayed in the main package. No preload or cache is present. What loads on the first home-only visit?

options.label: The main package; support waits until that feature is opened
options.feedback: The home screen does not need this support package under the stated conditions.

options.label: Only order data; page code stays on the server
options.feedback: The runtime needs the main package’s page code before it can run.

options.label: The main and support packages together as before
options.feedback: Ordinary subpackaging avoids requiring this feature code at first entry when it is not used.

lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这个微信小程序的代码包，把低频的退货和维修页放到售后分包，入口页与公共资源留在主包。完成后清楚说明哪些页面移动了，并在无缓存首次打开时核对：首页先取主包，进入售后才取分包，两个页面和订单数据都正常。

en.title: Send this to the AI Agent in your project
en.text: Inspect this WeChat mini program’s packages. Move rarely used return and repair pages into a support subpackage, keeping the entry and shared resources in the main package. Explain which pages moved. Without cached packages, verify the first home visit loads main, support loads on entry, and pages and order data still work.

learning.assumes: You have waited for a mini program to open a page.
learning.outcome: Separate downloading a code package from loading business data, and identify what must load first.

items.title: Keep the entry and shared resources in the main package
items.text: The entry screen and resources needed across ordinary subpackages remain available from the main package. A feature’s pages and private resources can move together.

items.title: Load according to the feature being opened
items.text: Opening a page in a subpackage can trigger its download. Preloading and caching can change the actual timing; inspect download records rather than assuming it.

modules.title: Does subpackaging make order requests faster?
modules.text: Subpackaging does not speed up slow API requests or reduce total code by itself. Size limits and independent-subpackage rules vary by platform and should be checked in the current documentation.

distinctions.label: Data request
distinctions.text: Retrieves order records or other business data. A subpackage contains the code and resources used to display and operate pages.

distinctions.label: File compression
distinctions.text: Reduces file size; subpackaging changes which code is needed at each stage. It does not remove the other code.
